newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends firm on NYMEX unleaded, stock data.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends firm on NYMEX unleaded, stock data.

text.p: NWE gasoline strengthened in afternoon trade on Wednesday on gains in NYMEX unleaded as well as bullish European and U.S. stock data, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $194.50 fob ARA for full April delivery.
While prompt barge material traded at $190.50 fob ARA for pre-April 15 delivery, and $192 and $193 for pre-April 20 delivery, traders were talking $193/$194 for April towards the end of the session.

Two players were particularly aggressive sellers throughout the day -- one of them was a key buyer back in March to the extent it almost kept prices propped-up singlehandedly at the time. Some sellers said they would stay on the sidelines while the low prompt offers persisted.
On the regular front, a barge parcel was done at $185 fob ARA in early trade.
Swaps also registered gains. May traded twice at $195.50 and near $196.25 mid-afternoon, but was talked at $195.50/$196 later on. April lay about one dollar below May levels.
Traders attributed the gains to improving NYMEX unleaded prices as well as bullish statistics with regards to stock levels on both sides of the Atlantic.

Euroilstock data showed European gasoline stocks dipped by 1.23 million, or 0.7 percent, in March to 164.82 million barrels. The drawdown was smaller than usual for the time of year but stocks were 5.60 million, 3.3 percent, lower than a year ago.
In the United States, American Petroleum Institute (API) data released on Tuesday showed that gasoline stocks were six million barrels below year ago levels.
